_comment: Job file for image_vector_to_labelme_pipeline.py. Copy, edit paths, run:
Nothing sensor-specific belongs here. Tile size, training overlap, the
sliver floor and band selection are derived from each mosaic's own GSD
and band count, so UAV 5 cm and WorldView-3 30 cm use the same file.
Required per job: name, mosaic, shapefile, id_field, and EITHER split
Optional per job: layer, split_layer, class_name, overlap, bands,
min_visible_area_m2 -- each overrides the derived value for that job only.
Relative paths resolve against this file's directory, which keeps a job
file portable between the Windows share and the Linux container.

jobs._note: A different sensor needs no extra settings -- only paths.
jobs.name: UAV_Liwa

jobs._note: Explicit bands only for a non-RGB composite, e.g. NIR-R-G.
jobs.name: WV3_NIR_example
